تستلفتون (form X)
# تَسْتَلْفِتُونَ (tastalfitūna) /tas.tal.fi.tuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَلْفَتَ (istalfata)
# تُسْتَلْفَتُونَ (tustalfatūna) /tus.tal.fa.tuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَلْفَتَ (istalfata)
